title: Marvel Fusion
summary: German fusion company using laser-driven proton-boron fuel.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Marvel Fusion is developing laser-driven fusion with proton-boron fuel, which avoids neutron activation but requires extreme laser intensity. It plans a demonstration facility and has partnered with research institutions. The physics and laser requirements are demanding.

Technology Exposure

  • Laser fusion
  • Proton-boron fuel
  • Demonstration facility

What To Watch

  • Laser performance
  • Funding
  • Physics validation

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
